remaining_limits: Owner visual acceptance remains pending; R8 integration and R9 review remain separate. Ordinary-world rollout is outside scope.
Full slabs conceal 0.125 m of narrow feet and fine slabs conceal 0.0625 m; zero visible broad-cabinet intersection is not zero total mesh penetration.

The visual cabinet/feet envelope is 1 x 0.55 x 0.8 m, inside the unchanged 1 x 0.7 x 0.8 m native storage/body box. Under-cabinet voids remain solid to native collision; visual cavity size does not change 960-unit capacity.
Rear-wall AABB overlap remains 0.025 m closed / 0.095433 m open in depth; low-ceiling open-lid overlap remains. No sweep refusal or placement tolerance rule is introduced.
Retained LF3/77 terrain checks cover three flat locations near home plus its existing paid floor chest. Arbitrary slopes, edges and unsupported placements are unmeasured.
Preservation of all 273 legal pairs is established by exact original game/data/native hashes; only the eight chest families and affected fixture flows are freshly exercised here.

Explicit supplied inspection stock and capture-paced motion do not establish a human first-hour journey. GIFs begin partway through opening and reset to their first real sample; closing is asserted separately.
One 300-frame benchmark per variant/backend on RTX 5090 is not minimum-hardware, long-session, GPU-time or statistical performance acceptance. Compatibility p95 rises 1.264 to 1.353 ms.
R5 consumes the common G2/G1 visual baseline only; R8 must reconcile replacement body GLBs with R2 texture-storage work and must not overwrite independent repairs with this entire runtime.
The fresh v03 application was byte-verified against every original runtime entry of tested v02; it was not imported or engine-run. Fresh engine import/restart evidence is from v02.
